nutrients.role: Chlorophyll synthesis, vegetative growth, protein formation.
nutrients.deficiency_symptoms: Uniform general yellowing (chlorosis) starting strictly from the older lower leaves first, while young leaves remain pale green. Stunted growth, thin stems, premature leaf shedding.
nutrients.affected_plant_part: Older lower leaves first (highly mobile nutrient)

crop_specific_manifestations.Rice: Uniform pale yellow canopy, restricted tillering, early heading with short panicles.
crop_specific_manifestations.Tomato: Lower leaves turn yellow, veins develop light purple tinge, slender rigid stems.
crop_specific_manifestations.Cotton: Lower leaves pale yellow, stunted stalks, small bolls.

nutrients.remediation: Apply Urea (46% N) @ 25-50 kg/ha or foliar spray 1-2% Urea solution (10-20g/L water) for rapid greening.

nutrients.role: Root elongation, energy transfer (ATP), flowering, seed development.
nutrients.deficiency_symptoms: Dark dull green foliage with conspicuous purple or bronze pigmentation on leaf undersides, petioles, and veins. Severely stunted root growth, delayed flowering and crop maturity.
nutrients.affected_plant_part: Older lower leaves and petioles (mobile nutrient)

crop_specific_manifestations.Tomato: Intense purple discoloration on undersides of leaves, poor root anchoring, blossom drop.
crop_specific_manifestations.Rice: Erect dark green leaves with purplish margins, delayed flowering.
crop_specific_manifestations.Pulses: Poor nodule development on roots, weak spindly stems.

nutrients.remediation: Apply Single Super Phosphate (SSP 16% P2O5) or DAP (18:46:0) as basal soil placement or foliar 1-2% DAP spray.

nutrients.role: Stomatal regulation, water economy, disease resistance, fruit size and sugar accumulation.
nutrients.deficiency_symptoms: Marginal scorching and leaf chlorosis starting at tips and margins of older leaves ('fired margin' or 'leaf burn'), curling upwards, weak lodging-prone stems, small flavorless fruits.
nutrients.affected_plant_part: Older leaves at margins and tips (mobile nutrient)

crop_specific_manifestations.Tomato: Marginal scorch on lower leaves, blotchy ripening, tasteless watery fruits, high vulnerability to Alternaria early blight.
crop_specific_manifestations.Banana: Rapid yellowing and scorching of leaf tips curving downward; weak bunches prone to snapping.
crop_specific_manifestations.Chilli: Marginal leaf burning, low capsaicin pungency, wrinkled fruit tip.

nutrients.remediation: Apply Muriate of Potash (MOP 60% K2O) or Potassium Sulphate (SOP 50% K2O) @ 25-50 kg/ha or foliar spray of 13:0:45 (Potassium nitrate) @ 10g/L.

nutrients.role: Cell wall structure (calcium pectate), membrane stability, pollen tube growth.
nutrients.deficiency_symptoms: Death of growing tips, distorted hooked young leaves with necrotic margins, blossom end rot in fruits, shell hollowness in nuts.
nutrients.affected_plant_part: Youngest expanding leaves and fruit distal ends (strictly immobile)

crop_specific_manifestations.Tomato: Blossom End Rot (BER): dark, water-soaked, sunken, leathery black flat lesion at the blossom end of fruits.
crop_specific_manifestations.Chilli: Sunken necrotic patch at the tip of developing pods.
crop_specific_manifestations.Groundnut: 'Pops' symptom: pods develop normally outside but contain hollow or shriveled seedless kernels inside.

nutrients.remediation: Soil application of Gypsum (Calcium sulphate) @ 400-500 kg/ha at pegging in groundnut; foliar drenching with Calcium Nitrate @ 5g/L on tomato and chilli.

nutrients.role: Central core atom of chlorophyll molecule, enzyme activator.
nutrients.deficiency_symptoms: Interveinal chlorosis strictly on older leaves where veins remain dark green while the area between veins turns bright yellow, bronze, or reddish purple.

crop_specific_manifestations.Cotton: 'Reddening of cotton leaves' (interveinal areas turn bright brick red, margins curl downwards, bolls remain small).
crop_specific_manifestations.Tomato: Brittle leaves with bright yellow interveinal mottling while main veins stay green.

nutrients.remediation: Foliar spray of Magnesium Sulphate (MgSO4) @ 10g/L (1%) + 10g/L Urea, repeated after 10-12 days.

nutrients.role: Auxin (IAA) synthesis, internode elongation, enzyme activation.
nutrients.deficiency_symptoms: Interveinal chlorosis on middle to young leaves, severe shortening of internodes causing 'little leaf' or 'rosette' appearance, rusty bronze pigmentation.

crop_specific_manifestations.Rice: 'Khaira disease': 2-3 weeks after transplanting, lower leaves develop reddish-brown or bronze rust-like spots that coalesce, severely retarding growth.
crop_specific_manifestations.Tomato: Puckered small leaves, severe interveinal bronzing.
crop_specific_manifestations.Cotton: Cupped small leaves with interveinal bleaching.

nutrients.remediation: Basal application of Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4 21%) @ 25 kg/ha or foliar spray of Chelated Zinc (Zn-EDTA 12%) @ 1.0g/L or 0.5% ZnSO4 + 0.25% lime.

nutrients.deficiency_symptoms: Sharp and severe interveinal chlorosis on the youngest terminal leaves; leaf blade turns ivory white or pale yellow while veins remain sharply green like a fine network.

crop_specific_manifestations.Groundnut: Lime-induced chlorosis in calcareous soils (top leaves turn completely bleached white).
crop_specific_manifestations.Rice: Nurseries raised on high pH soils show bleached white seedlings ('nursery chlorosis').

nutrients.remediation: Foliar spray of Ferrous Sulphate (FeSO4) @ 10g/L + 1g/L Citric acid or Chelated Iron (Fe-EDTA) @ 1.5g/L.

nutrients.role: Sugar translocation, pollen germination, fruit setting, cell wall synthesis.
nutrients.deficiency_symptoms: Death of terminal apical growing points, brittle curled young leaves, excessive flower drop, internal fruit cracking and corky tissue formation.
nutrients.affected_plant_part: Growing shoot tip, flowers, and developing fruits

crop_specific_manifestations.Tomato: Excessive flower drop, fruit cracking (star cracks around calyx), internal browning.
crop_specific_manifestations.Coconut: 'Crown choking', small malformed nuts with crinkled husk, heavy button shedding.
crop_specific_manifestations.Chilli: Deformed small fruits with blossom drop.

nutrients.remediation: Soil application of Borax @ 10 kg/ha or foliar spray of Solubor (20% B) @ 1.0g/L at flower initiation.
